label: Healthy
note: Baseline motion: shaft, impellers, and coupling rotate together. Illustrative simulation.

label: Shaft seal leak
note: Leakage at the shaft seal (I&O section 13-14: check for leaks particularly at the shaft seal). Motion unchanged. Illustrative.

label: Worn impeller
note: Worn eyelet or neck-ring contact surface cuts shutoff head (section 19 problem 2f check). Illustrative.

label: Clogged passage
note: Clogged impeller or guide-vane passage (section 19 problem 2g): flow starved, output drops. Illustrative.

label: Coupling misset
note: Improper coupling setting (section 19 problem 2i): tight rotation and impeller rub against chambers. Illustrative.
